response.query: Which error-mitigation sequence (ZNE, randomized compiling, measurement-error mitigation) and expected overheads should be applied per hardware?
response.answer: For error mitigation, use ZNE on noisy hardware; randomized compiling and measurement-error mitigation on more stable systems. Overheads vary, typically ZNE has minimal overhead, while randomized compiling can add moderate overhead.
